    """ brackets is a string of "<" and ">".
    return True if every opening bracket has a corresponding closing bracket
    and a single outermost pair encloses the entire string.

    >>> correct_bracketing("<")
    False
    >>> correct_bracketing("<>")
    True
    >>> correct_bracketing("<<><>>")
    True
    >>> correct_bracketing("><<>")
    False
    >>> correct_bracketing("<><>")
    False
    """
    if not brackets:
        return False
    depth = 0

            depth += 1
        elif b == ">":

        if depth < 0:

        if depth == 0 and i != last:
            return False
    return depth == 0
